2.msg: What's wrong? What happened? Are you lost?

3.msg: Sniff... It was those monsters! They're... sniffle... horrible!

4.msg: What did they do? They're bothering you?

5.msg: Yes. They called me mean names, and they took the #btreasure I was hiding#k.

6.msg: How dare they?! Punks like that ought to be taught a lesson. Where are they? I'll take on #b300#k of them!

7.msg: You're really going to help me? The monsters that were bothering me are the #bMonsters Near Your Level#k of #b#h0##k. Be careful. They're super strong and just as mean! Oh, and Monsters Near Your Level are as many as #r#e20 levels below and 20 levels above your own#k#n. So, if you're Lv. 50, then look for Lv. 30-70 monsters.

yes.0: All right! If you punish those big meanies and get back the #btreasure I was hiding#k, I can share some of it with you!
yes.1: Every day before you start, click #e<Challenge>#n in the Attendance Log in the Star Notifier on the left side of the screen. Then you'll be all set!
yes.2: #b#h0##k, I'll always remember you as an amazing hero. I'll share my treasure with you too!
yes.3: Great! Remember to check the Attendance Log in the Star Notifier on the left side of the screen, okay? Good luck!
